title: Marginal distribution on a subset
statement: Let $J$ be a subset of an $n$-element set. The distribution obtained by restricting a Shapley-random subset to $J$ equals the Shapley subset distribution on a ground set of size $|J|$, with elements identified through the order-preserving enumeration of $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a subset of the ground set
